pattern: に則って（にのっとって）
purpose: Act in accordance with an established norm or procedure.
keywords: We will handle it in accordance with the rules.
We held the ceremony according to tradition.
We protect rights in accordance with the law.
restrictions: The noun is usually a law, rule, principle, or custom.
mistake: Use に即して for adapting to actual conditions.
